# Name Calendar operation constants at the transaction dispatch call

Entry 2102 removes OP_ADD, OP_MODIFY and OP_DELETE aliases and writes Ci.calIOperationListener constants directly at all ten dispatch calls. The same form remains in the fixed accepted transaction classes. This makes the owning interface visible at the operation boundary without a second naming layer. _dispatch passes the value to cal.itip.checkAndSend, which creates outgoing scheduling messages. Mutation still completes before dispatch; a cross-calendar modification still adds then dispatches ADD, deletes the old item then dispatches DELETE. This is a naming/syntax change in this module, not a transaction recovery change or a ban on useful constants. Current unit tasks cover basic add/modify/delete and undo but do not assert dispatch codes. No unit, scheduling, runtime or accessibility test ran. External context is pending.

Scope: Calendar transaction syntax and operation identity.
